notes.title: POLYWAR's latest update is now up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Polywar's just recieved its latest update!
In this update you will find many different improvements.
We are also currently working on new maps and weapons as well as adding more features, so in the months to come you can expect these updates to go live!
Help it to gain popularity now by playing it with your friends! If you do, you'll recieve a special weapon and a special skin for the blow bang gun!

To help stop the cheaters, we have bought new servers and closed the old ones. This means that cheaters will no longer be able to play the pre-elpha version and ruin the experience for everyone else.

Have fun and happy shooting!

notes.title: Latest From Exagon Games, W.O.R.B.I.T.S!
notes.content:
Exagon games are creating a new, artistic and psychedelic FPS that POLYWAR players will just love! With interesting mechanics and psychedelic maps, you'll spend hours playing this great game! 
But first we need your help to get it through Steam Greenlight!  If you're interested, click on the link below to check it out and if you want to play it, then click the thumbs up button to help this game become a reality! 
If you have any feedback/constructive criticism for the developers, please comment on the Greenlight page and we'll pass it on, to help this game grow to bigger and better things!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=874820157

notes.content:

Regarding the lack of players right now, we are trying to get publicity for this game and have already had some people say they'll review it, so don't worry, we're doing everything we can!
Now go fly high and shoot  lots! ;)

notes.title: Another Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we found yet another bug and have now fixed it! 
The controls are as follows:
[list]
[*]Mouse Left: Shot
[*]Mouse Center: Secondary Weapon (not for every weapon)
[*]Mouse Right: Aim/Shot
[*]WASD: Movements
[*]SPACE: Jump/DoubleJump
[*]R: Reload (not for every weapon: other has auto-reload)
[*]Q: Change Viewfinder (not for every weapon)
[*]E: Melee Weapon (not for every weapon)
[*]G: Grenade
[*]X: Superpower (unlockable on the menu)
[/list]
Please let us know when you encounter bugs as we aim to please and will work on them ASAP!

Happy shooting! ;)
